A classic crewneck with a tactile chenille graphic that feels straight out of the archives. Comfortable, substantial, and easy to layer, this is the kind of sweatshirt that makes even a simple fit look considered.

CT TECH
Soft like cotton. Sharp like tech. CT TECH is built for the golfer who values comfort as much as performance. By blending ultra-fine Pima cotton yarns with technical polyester fibers, this fabric feels soft and breathable like your favorite tee but performs with the durability and function of modern activewear. It wicks moisture, resists odor, and offers UPF 50+ protection, all while maintaining a natural cotton hand feel that wears just as well off the course. Designed to hold its shape and require minimal maintenance, CT TECH is the kind of fabric that keeps you looking sharp and feeling at ease, whether you’re chasing birdies or chasing daylight.

title: Ace Raglan 1/4 Zip
body_html:
A versatile layering piece designed for comfort and mobility. The Ace Raglan 1/4 Zip features a smooth, stretchy performance fabric with a relaxed athletic fit that layers easily over polos or tees. Ideal for early tee times, travel days, or cooler afternoons.

AG TECH
Engineered for performance. Built for the heat. AG TECH is our most technically advanced knit, developed for the player who demands peak performance from their wardrobe. Crafted from a refined blend of full dull polyester yarns and spandex, it delivers a soft, supple hand feel with a matte finish and built-in stretch. Lightweight and highly breathable, this fabric moves with you and keeps you cool when the game heats up. Moisture-wicking and antimicrobial properties work overtime to manage sweat and odor, while UPF 50+ sun protection and wrinkle-resistant construction make it a reliable go-to for long days on the course. Whether you’re walking 18 or grinding through a summer range session, AG TECH is made to keep you dry, focused, and comfortable from the first tee to the last putt.

title: Tech Stretch Vest
body_html:
Your secret weapon. This high gauge vest offers four-way stretch tech fabric for maximum movement. This vest is great for layering against the elements, keeping you dry and comfortable all-day long with both wind and water resistance. Zippers on the pockets keep your belongings safely tucked away. The Golfman embroidered logo reminds you that Ashworth is the OG of golfwear.

Model: Keith is 6'2 and wears a size Medium in Ashworth Golf.

AG TECH
Engineered for performance. Built for the heat. AG TECH is our most technically advanced knit, developed for the player who demands peak performance from their wardrobe. Crafted from a refined blend of full dull polyester yarns and spandex, it delivers a soft, supple hand feel with a matte finish and built-in stretch. Lightweight and highly breathable, this fabric moves with you and keeps you cool when the game heats up. Moisture-wicking and antimicrobial properties work overtime to manage sweat and odor, while UPF 50+ sun protection and wrinkle-resistant construction make it a reliable go-to for long days on the course. Whether you’re walking 18 or grinding through a summer range session, AG TECH is made to keep you dry, focused, and comfortable from the first tee to the last putt.
